
```{r}
library("fixest")
data(base_did)
scipubs = with(
  base_did,
  data.frame(
    articles = round(y - min(y)),
    funding = round(x1 - min(x1)) * 10,
    eu_us = ifelse(treat, "EU", "US"),
    policy = +(period - id > 0),
    indiv = id,
    year = period
  )
)
```

## 2.0.1 Ordinary least squares estimation
Similar to LM but better
```{r}
feols(articles ~ funding + as.factor(indiv) + as.factor(year), scipubs)
```

Use | to speed up processing
```{r}
feols(articles ~ funding | indiv + year, scipubs)
```

Cluster standard errors

```{r}
feols(articles ~ funding | indiv + year, scipubs, vcov = ~indiv)
```

Effecient way to check multiple error computations

```{r}
feols(articles ~ funding | indiv + year, scipubs) |>
  etable(vcov = list("iid", ~indiv))
```

Estimate separate models for each region

```{r}
feols(articles ~ funding | indiv + year, scipubs, split = ~eu_us) |>
  etable()
```
